settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Is this customizable for my clinic?
settings.text1: Yes. The flyer and social templates are editable so you can add your logo and contact details.
settings.text2: Yes. All digital files are high resolution and formatted for professional printing.
settings.title3: Is this suitable for new providers?
settings.text3: Yes. The brochures and templates support education and simplify client conversations.
settings.title4: Can I use the social templates immediately?
settings.text4: Yes. Ready-to-post versions are included for immediate publishing.
